checks.title: Ensure Telnet access is disabled on all firewall interfaces
checks.rationale: Cleartext Telnet exposes administrator login passwords and security appliance configuration across transit links.

checks.title: Ensure HTTP ASDM server access is restricted to authorized subnets
checks.rationale: Enabling ASDM HTTP management access without source IP restrictions exposes the administrative web interface to unauthorized hosts.

checks.title: Ensure SSH version 2 is enforced
checks.rationale: Legacy SSH version 1 contains known protocol vulnerabilities. Only SSHv2 must be permitted on the ASA management plane.

checks.title: Ensure SSH timeout interval is configured to 10 minutes or fewer
checks.rationale: Inactive SSH management sessions should automatically disconnect to prevent unauthorized administrative use of unattended terminals.

checks.title: Detect overly permissive access-lists (permit ip any any)
checks.command: show running-config | include access-list .* permit ip any any
checks.rationale: Permit ip any any access control entries disable stateful filtering and allow uncontrolled transit traffic across security boundaries.
checks.remediation: Remove broad any-any permit rules and implement granular destination IP, object-group, and port restrictions.

checks.title: Detect unrestricted outside ingress to sensitive ports (SSH 22, RDP 3389, SMB 445)
checks.command: show running-config | include access-list outside_in permit .* (eq 22|eq 3389|eq 445)
checks.rationale: Direct inbound public exposure of SSH, Remote Desktop Protocol, or SMB allows adversaries to perform credential brute-forcing and exploit remote flaws.
checks.remediation: Remove inbound access-list entries opening ports 22, 3389, and 445 on external interfaces; require AnyConnect / IPsec VPN.

checks.title: Ensure implicit deny traffic is logged on perimeter access-lists
checks.command: show running-config | include access-list .* deny ip any any log
checks.rationale: While the ASA drops unmatched packets by default, explicitly configuring 'deny ip any any log' generates syslog alerts for dropped traffic analysis.
checks.remediation: access-list <acl-name> extended deny ip any any log default

checks.title: Ensure stateful application inspection is active in global policy map
checks.rationale: Stateful L4-L7 Modular Policy Framework (MPF) inspection validates packet RFC adherence and payload structure for standard services.
checks.remediation:
policy-map global_policy
class inspection_default
inspect dns
inspect ftp
inspect icmp
exit

checks.title: Ensure remote Syslog server logging is enabled
checks.rationale: Centralized logging ensures security violations, connection teardowns, and administrative changes are permanently recorded in a SIEM.
checks.remediation:
logging enable
logging host inside <syslog-ip>
logging trap informational

checks.title: Ensure NTP time synchronization is configured
checks.rationale: Accurate timestamps are required for digital evidence, certificate validity checks, and synchronized threat intelligence.

checks.title: Ensure default SNMP community strings (public/private) are removed
checks.rationale: Default community strings public and private allow unauthorized users to query network interface states and router metrics.
checks.remediation:
no snmp-server community public
no snmp-server community private
